Mr. Dinesh Gahatori, learned counsel for the 
petitioner(s). 
2. Mr. Narayan Dutt, learned Standing Counsel for the 
State.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that 
petitioners are retired employees of Government Inter 
College, who retired before the year 2013, but till date their 
pension has not been sanctioned and the retiral dues has not 
been paid to them, despite approaching this Court by the 
petitioners twice earlier and respondent-State despite clear 
instructions failed to file any counter affidavit in this matter.
4. Learned counsel for the State submitted that earlier 
the file was allotted to Ms. Menka Tripathi, Advocate, who 
is no more in the Panel of the State and the file has now 
been allotted to Mr. Narayan Dutt, Standing Counsel.
5. In the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case 
and on the aforesaid ground two weeks’ further time is 
granted to learned counsel for the State to file its counter 
affidavit.
6. Further one week’s time is granted to learned counsel 
for the petitioners for filing rejoinder affidavit.
7. List this case on 09.01.2024.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
